name: bringup-e1-dataplane
about: Bring-up matrix row dataplane (E1): the wifi-datapath-bringup lane's ladder D on the dp-capable hi5622_wifi driver (module 462,952 B sha256 8fc693ad..., attrs dp_probe/dp_setup/dp_status/dp_rings + the h2d_txq_addr_sync alias). PD4 golden boot -> ONE ctx-create -> ONE read-only MAC slot-5 reachability probe (dp_probe) -> ONE dp_setup (ring/table allocation + MAC band-0 program with read-back) -> ONE TXQ-table address sync g0 id1 key 0x0320 -> post packs. One setup + one hand-off per module load; no retry. MAC ring register programming is the driver's action (never automation devmem).

steps.name: note
steps.about: E1 mirrors wifi-datapath-bringup BENCH-LADDER D0-D3 (and its sequences/ladder-d-datapath.json): read-only probe then ONE setup then ONE key-0x0320 hand-off. Stop after the post pack; a failed step is a discovery, never a retry, and the PD4 cave poll loop is one-shot per load.

steps.name: dp-seed
steps.about: the ready handshake seeded the data plane: g4 id2 payload 0x01060850 = the device-RAM MSDU-info ring-pointer table (ACP-mapped into MAC +0x10)

steps.name: pre-pack
steps.about: clean control state before the data-plane actions: exception mask 0, staging 0, out[0] (CA 0x40039010) 0

steps.name: ctx-create-t1
steps.about: ONE ordered context-create H2D (g0 id1 key 0x64, type 1) - the precondition of the key-addressed data-plane frame

steps.name: post-create-status
steps.about: the create was committed and the core moved ACTIVE (the second frame's legality)

steps.name: dp-probe
steps.about: ONE read-only MAC band-0 word read (CA 0x40040000+0x00). The gate is that the region-3 window answered without a bus error; the value is captured (vendor boot 0x00000100, 0/other recorded and setup may still run). This settles the datapath lane's BAR0 0x402A000-vs-region-3 open question with a driver-mediated read.

steps.name: dp-setup
steps.about: ONE data-plane setup: allocate TXQ table 0x2524 + 8x64x8 TX MSDU rings + tx_ba_info 0x800 + RX free rings 256/512 + completion ring 4095 + 0x63c/0xb0 pools; write the 8 device-RAM MSDU-info table entries through ACP; program MAC band-0 in vendor order with read-back verify. No retry.

steps.name: dp-rings-check
steps.about: live MAC band-0 snapshot: RX free-ring producers published full (index 0/phase 1), vendor interrupt mask, and the device-RAM TX MSDU-table entries readable

steps.name: pre-txq-status
steps.about: the key-0x0320 hand-off is legal now (dp_setup done) and has not been sent

steps.name: dp-txq-sync
steps.about: ONE g0 id1 key-0x0320 TXQ-table address sync frame (32 B, 4-byte device VA of the 0x2524-byte host TXQ table) through the exact H2D carrier + coalesced mailbox id-3 announce + bounded out[0] poll. No retry.

steps.name: post-txq-pack
steps.about: the whole point: no exception after the MAC program and the 0x0320 frame; page/state still golden; mailbox drains

steps.name: catalog-after
steps.about: post-run D2H catalogue delta capture (the 0x320 worker has no known D2H answer; evidence, not a gate)

steps.name: done-note
steps.about: E1 row PASS = dp_probe answered, dp_setup verified (14 MAC regs / 8 table entries), the 0x0320 frame consumed with mask/staging 0 and page/state golden. Stop the boot here: one setup + one hand-off per load, no retry.
